newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Erbakan to meet opposition leader.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Erbakan to meet opposition leader.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan was to meet main opposition leader Mesut Yilmaz on Wednesday amid doubts over the government's future.
Erbakan's office said in a statement he would hold talks with Motherland Party (ANAP) leader Yilmaz in parliament at 1100 (0900 GMT).
The Islamist-led coalition has been hit by an order from the secularist military to clamp down on a recent wave of Moslem activism.
Parliamentary sources said conservative Yilmaz was likely to tell the prime minister to heed the army.
Erbakan, modern Turkey's first Islamist leader, won two censure motion votes in parliament on Tuesday but his majorities were thin compared to recent similar ballotting.
Several deputies from junior coalition partner Tansu Ciller's True Path Party did not turn up for the vote.
